market_context: Stocks are mixed on Election Day. Chipmakers are bouncing after the semiconductor index fell into a bear market, which lifts Nasdaq and S&P while Apple's weak margin outlook drags the Dow. The 10-year yield is near 4.95%, oil is falling on US-Iran talk hopes, and AMD reports after the close. Election results come tonight.

predictions.reasoning: The S&P is up about 0.4%, helped by a chip rebound and falling oil, with VIX easing to about 20.7. The 10-year yield near 4.95% and election uncertainty limit the upside. Monday's rally faded late, so I'm only slightly bullish.

Nvidia is bouncing about 3% after four straight losing sessions, and chips are rebounding from an oversold bear-market level. AMD earnings after the close could support AI names into the bell, though a late fade is possible.
The Dow is down about 0.5%, pulled lower by Apple, Salesforce and IBM, and rising yields hurt it. Rotation away from the Dow's names continues, so I lean slightly toward it staying weak.
